mapper.select: SELECT bed.id, bed.bed_type, bed.bed_frame_id, CASE WHEN bed.bed_type IN ('BUNK_UPPER','BUNK_LOWER') THEN 'BUNK' WHEN bed.bed_type='SINGLE_BED' THEN 'SINGLE_BED' ELSE 'LOFT_BED_DESK' END AS layout_unit_type FROM bed WHERE bed.room_id=#{roomId} AND bed.operational_status<>'RETIRED' ORDER BY bed.position_index, bed.id
